senses.gloss: (b. h.) to interweave, interlace, esp. to make a hedge or dam with twigs, stones &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:8">Shebi. III, 8</cite> <he>לא יִסְבּוֹךְ בעפר</he> Ms. M. a. R. S. a. l. (ed. <he>יסמוך</he>) he must not cover the dam with earth, opp. <he>עושה חייץ</he>, v. <cite ref="H00744"><he>חַיִיץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29">Lev. R. s. 29</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00591"><he>נָטַשׁ</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782">Yalk. Num. 782</cite>, v. infra; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>מִסְתַּבְּכִין בצרות</he> entangled in troubles.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>עתידין בניך להִסְתַּבֵּךְ במלכיות ונמשכין ממלכות למלכות</he> thy children will be entangled (come in conflict) with successive empires, and be drawn from empire to empire; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782:14">Yalk. Num. 782</cite> <he>נִסְבָּכִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>ונ׳ בשערו</he> and the chaff stuck in his hair. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot. <he>נִסְתַּבְּכוּ בגדיו וכ׳</he> if his garments were caught in thorns; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:3">Peah VII, 3</cite> [read:] <he>עקץ … ה׳ בעלים ונפל לארץ וכ׳</he> if he cut a cluster off by its stalk, and it was intercepted by the foliage, and in falling to the ground single berries fell off.

senses.gloss: to entangle. [Y. Kil. II, end, 28ᵇ מסבכין, some ed., v. סָכַךְ.]—Part. pass. מְסוּבָּךְ.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 30b:9">Ḥull. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>תחת צמר מס׳</he> if he put the slaughtering knife under the entangled wool (on the animal’s neck).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 6a:2">M. Kat. 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>במְסוּבָּכִין</he> when the trees in the field are irregularly scattered (not planted in rows).

<cite ref="Sotah 48a">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 292">Yalk. Is. 292</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="A03052"><he>ארזה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Zephaniah 2:14">Zeph. II, 14</cite>) <he>בית המסובך בארזים</he> a house which lies in a thicket of cedars.
